1.1.0: Added MakeApiCall component for making arbitrary authenticated API calls to Clerk API.
1.2.0: feat: update MakeApiCall component to match standard spec (add headers, parameters inputs; fix output format)
1.2.1: Added output examples to component schemas.
2.0.0: (breaking change) MakeApiCall: headers and parameters changed to key-value array inputs (body remains textarea/JSON to support nested structures) per standard #1459 — existing flows that used the old string/textarea headers or parameters must be updated
2.0.1: Fixed a crash when a Find/List component saved an EMPTY result set to a CSV file — the header row was built from the first record without checking there was one, so a search that legitimately matched nothing failed the flow instead of writing an empty file.
2.0.2: Added missing output examples to CreateUser and GetOrganization.
